designationHistory.indexText: Overflow National Wildlife Refuge (NWR) was established in 1980 to protect the bottomland hardwood forest, a vital habitat for migratory waterfowl populations along the Mississippi Flyway.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
